title: Vectors: Link layer test vectors
description: Verify/complete test/vectors/link-*.json. Cover: frame encoding, EUI-64 derivation, replay window, Schnorr signatures. All three implementations must pass.
close_reason: Link-layer vectors complete with Python/Rust consumers. Frame encoding: link_frame.json + link_frame_signed_modes.json. EUI-64: link-addressing.json. Replay: replay_window.json + epoch_rollover.json. Schnorr: schnorr48.json + signed frame vectors. Fixed stale link-edge-fuzz.json (E=1 unsigned now parser-reject; length 0xFF is frame_too_large). Added Python and Rust parse consumers. Tests green: pytest 296 passed; cargo test -p lichen-link --features schnorr,std --test shared_vectors --test schnorr48_vectors --test link_edge_fuzz_vectors.
